close_reason: Added BackendCallFnWithCtx<B,C> type alias and ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B,C> struct with JmapHandler<C> impl that forwards caller to closure; 2 tests (closure_handler_with_ctx_forwards_caller, compile-time trait check); 76 tests pass; clippy clean.
description:
Add a CallerCtx-aware closure type to jmap-server so register_*_handlers functions can forward per-request context to handler closures.

Current state:
- BackendCallFn<B> = Fn(Arc<B>, String, Value) -> HandlerFuture (no CallerCtx)
- ClosureHandler<B> calls the closure and discards _caller: C

Required change:
1. Add BackendCallFnWithCtx<B, C> = Fn(Arc<B>, String, Value, C) -> HandlerFuture + Send + Sync + 'static
2. Add ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> struct that stores Box<BackendCallFnWithCtx<B, C>>
3. impl<B, C: Clone + Send + 'static> JmapHandler<C> for ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> — forwards caller to the closure
4. Add a companion macro or helper in each register_*_handlers crate (or expose the type from jmap-server)

Keep existing ClosureHandler<B> for backward compat — it is used by tests and downstream code that does not need CallerCtx.

Acceptance criteria:
- ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> compiles and passes JmapHandler<C> impl
- Existing ClosureHandler tests unchanged
- cargo test --workspace exits 0
- Clippy clean
title: jmap-server: Add CallerCtx-forwarding ClosureHandler variant
